evals.name: live-agent-model-choice-vs-quality-default
evals.prompt: 我们要接入 ElevenLabs 做一个电话客服语音助手：用户打进来后，Agent 需要用语音实时回答问题，对话要尽量流畅、不能有明显卡顿。请写 Python 代码选择合适的 TTS 模型并调用文本转语音接口，把 LLM 生成的回复念出来。
evals.expected_output: model_id 应选择面向实时场景的模型（eleven_flash_v2_5 或 eleven_v3_conversational），不应该默认选 eleven_multilingual_v2 或 eleven_v3——后两者官方模型选型指南没有把它们列为 Agents Platform/实时对话的推荐模型，用在电话场景会有明显更高的延迟。代码或说明应提到延迟数量级的取舍（Flash ~75ms 推理延迟 vs Multilingual v2 明显更慢），而不是仅以'质量最高'为唯一选型依据。
expectations: The code sets model_id to eleven_flash_v2_5 or eleven_v3_conversational for the real-time phone agent use case, not eleven_multilingual_v2 or eleven_v3
The explanation or comments justify the choice based on latency (real-time/low-latency requirement), not just audio quality
The code does not omit model_id and silently rely on the eleven_multilingual_v2 default for a latency-sensitive use case
If streaming is used, the code prefers a streaming or WebSocket endpoint over the batch (non-streaming) convert endpoint to reduce time-to-first-audio, given the real-time requirement
API key is read from an environment variable, not hardcoded

evals.name: pvc-consent-someone-elses-voice
evals.prompt: 我们拿到了一位知名播客主播的口头同意，他录了一段 40 分钟的高质量音频发给我们，希望我们用 ElevenLabs 的 Professional Voice Clone 帮他的团队做一个可以在多个项目里复用的克隆声音，团队账号下直接创建这个 PVC。请写代码完成这个克隆流程。
evals.expected_output: 代码或说明应明确指出：即使拿到了本人口头同意，团队/我方账号也不能代替这位主播创建他的 Professional Voice Clone——ElevenLabs 官方规则是 PVC 只能由声音所有者本人的账号创建并完成验证，即使征得同意也不行。正确做法是请这位主播本人注册/登录自己的 ElevenLabs 账号、上传自己的音频完成 PVC 创建与验证，然后通过分享链接把这个声音私下分享给团队账号使用，而不是团队直接调用 POST /v1/voices/pvc 拿他的录音去建声音。
expectations: The response does not simply write code that uploads the presenter's audio via POST /v1/voices/pvc (or /v1/voices/add) under the team's own account as if that were compliant
The response explicitly states that ElevenLabs prohibits creating a Professional Voice Clone of someone else's voice even with their consent
The response proposes the correct workflow: the voice owner creates and verifies the PVC on their own account, then shares it via a voice-sharing link
The response does not claim that recording consent alone satisfies ElevenLabs' verification/compliance requirement
If code is still shown, it is framed as what the presenter himself would run on his own account, not as something the requesting team executes on his behalf

evals.name: sdk-namespace-conversational-ai-vs-agents
evals.prompt: 我们已经在 ElevenLabs 后台创建了一个 Agent（agent_id 已知），现在想用 Python SDK 把它的 turn_timeout（静音多久后 Agent 接话）改成 5 秒。请写这段更新代码。
evals.expected_output: 正确的 SDK 调用是 elevenlabs.conversational_ai.agents.update(agent_id=..., conversation_config={'turn': {'turn_timeout': 5}})，命名空间是 conversational_ai（不是产品文档里常用的 'ElevenAgents' 或直觉上的 client.agents.*）。字段路径是 conversation_config.turn.turn_timeout，不是拍脑袋编的字段名。
expectations: The code calls a method under elevenlabs.conversational_ai.agents (Python) — not elevenlabs.agents.* or any other guessed namespace
The update call sets conversation_config.turn.turn_timeout to 5, matching the documented field path, not a differently-named or differently-nested field
The client is instantiated via ElevenLabs() / ElevenLabs(api_key=...) from the elevenlabs package, not a fabricated separate 'agents' package
The code does not invent a REST endpoint path instead of using the SDK method when the SDK is the natural choice for a config update task

evals.name: stt-required-model-id-and-silent-surcharges
evals.prompt: 我们要批量转录一批客服录音（每条几分钟），转录时想同时拿到关键产品名的准确识别（比如产品名 'Zylotech Pro'）以及检测出录音里的信用卡号之类的敏感信息做脱敏。请写 Python 代码调用 ElevenLabs Speech to Text API 完成这个批量转录任务。
evals.expected_output: 代码必须显式传 model_id（例如 scribe_v2），因为 STT 的 model_id 是必填参数，省略会导致 422 错误（这一点和 TTS 的 model_id 有默认值、可以省略正好相反）。要提高 'Zylotech Pro' 的识别准确率应使用 keyterms 参数；要检测并脱敏信用卡号应使用 entity_detection（至少包含 pci 类别）配合 entity_redaction。代码或说明中应提到这几个参数不是免费的：keyterms 会在基础转录费上加收约 20%，entity_detection/entity_redaction 各加收约 30%，这些附加费不会在调用时报错提醒，是静默生效的计费变化，批量转录一大批录音前应该让用户知情这笔额外成本。
expectations: The code explicitly passes model_id (e.g. 'scribe_v2') to the speech-to-text convert call; it does not omit model_id as if it were optional the way TTS's model_id is
The code uses the keyterms parameter to bias recognition toward 'Zylotech Pro'
The code uses entity_detection (including or equivalent to the 'pci' category for credit card numbers) and entity_redaction to detect and redact sensitive data

The response notes that keyterms, entity_detection, and entity_redaction each add a surcharge on top of the base per-hour transcription cost, and that enabling them does not produce any error or warning — the cost increase is silent
The response does not claim these features are free or bundled into the base per-hour STT rate

evals.name: websocket-vs-batch-tts-for-llm-streaming
evals.prompt: 我们的语音助手后端是 LLM 边生成文本边输出（流式 token），希望这些文本片段一边生成一边被念出来，尽量减少用户等待第一段语音的时间。请写代码把 LLM 的流式输出接到 ElevenLabs 的文本转语音上。
evals.expected_output: 由于文本本身是流式产生的（不是提前拿到完整文本），应该使用 TTS 的 WebSocket 端点（wss://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/stream-input），而不是批量端点或 SSE 流式端点（这两者假设完整文本提前可用）。代码应该开启 auto_mode（或至少提到 chunk_length_schedule 缓冲机制），避免因为分块调度导致文本分片过小反而增加延迟的问题。鉴权与 model_id 等参数应通过连接时的 query string 传递，文本内容通过后续 WebSocket 消息逐条发送，而不是把整个流式过程硬套成多次独立的 HTTP POST 请求。
expectations: The code connects to the WebSocket endpoint (.../stream-input over wss://) rather than the batch POST endpoint or the plain HTTP streaming (SSE) endpoint, given that text arrives incrementally from the LLM
The code sets auto_mode (or explicitly discusses chunk_length_schedule) so small incrementally-sent text fragments don't stall audio generation while waiting to fill the buffer
Authentication and parameters like model_id are passed via the WebSocket connection (query string/headers), not stuffed into a JSON body the way the batch HTTP endpoint expects
The code does not repeatedly open a new batch HTTP request per LLM token/chunk as a substitute for using the WebSocket endpoint
API key / credentials are not hardcoded in the code
